name: Parents of Chinmayee | Grade: II
feedback: We chose Indian Public School for our daughter Chinmayee’s I Class and it has been a wonderful decision. She comes from a different state and environment, but the school and her teachers made her feel comfortable and welcomed from the very beginning. The teachers have been extremely supportive and helped her overcome her initial discomfort.

name: Parents of Aadhrith | Grade: III
feedback: As parents of Aadhrith, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for the excellent all-round development provided by the school. The curriculum is age-appropriate and perfectly blends literature, mathematics and science. Our child comes home excited to share new knowledge, which reflects a strong eagerness to learn.

name: Parents of Puneet Agrawal | Grade: IV
feedback: Indian Public School is an English-medium school and one of the best schools in our city. Students learn new things every day at the school. The school has a very clean and natural environment along with a big playground. All the teachers are very polite, supportive, kind, loving, cooperative and intelligent. The teachers help students differentiate between good and bad in life.

name: Parents of Anwesha | Grade: VIII
feedback: We have enrolled our child Anwesha Brahma (Grade 8th) in IPS this year. We appreciate the motivating and open culture of the school. The staff is well qualified and courteous. Kids are encouraged to interact and not be afraid of their teachers. They respect their teachers and are making good progress in all areas. We are thankful to the Teaching Staff and the Management for our kids’ progress.

name: Parents of Pratyusha Chandra |  Grade: VIII
feedback: We parents of Pratyusha Chandra, Class VII, feel happy to write about Indian Public School. My daughter is happy going to school. Teachers are supportive and caring. Good manners and etiquettes are also emphasised along with academic development. There has been a great change in her, and we wholeheartedly give the credit to the school for grooming her.

name: Parents of Divjot Singh | Grade: IX
feedback: I’m very much thankful to the teachers and the entire team of the school for the holistic and good development of my child. I have witnessed good communication and speaking skills in him. He is able to cope up with many things related to studies and his future. Thanks once again for your each and every effort.

name: Parents of Mayank Kumar Pradhan | Grade: VII
feedback: Respected Principal and all teachers of Indian Public School, I am highly thankful to you for the efforts taken by you to be in touch with the students online during the lockdown period. I am very happy. I would like to thank and appreciate the creative modules prepared by the teachers.

name: Parents of Ayush Brahma | Grade: XI
feedback: We have enrolled our child Ayush Brahma (Grade 11th) in IPS this year. We appreciate the motivating and open culture of the school. The staff is well qualified and courteous. Kids are encouraged to interact and not be afraid of their teachers. They respect their teachers and are making good progress in all areas. We are thankful to the Teaching Staff and the Management for our kids’ progress.

name: Palak Sahu | Grade: III
feedback: I, Palak Sahu of Class III, sincerely appreciate my school for providing a wonderful environment for learning and growth. Our teachers are dedicated, caring and always encourage us to give our best in academics and activities. My school not only imparts knowledge but also teaches us values, discipline and confidence. I feel honoured and proud to be a student of such a great institution. My school helps me discover my talents and inspires me to dream big. We are encouraged to participate in sports, arts and cultural activities. Every day at school is full of learning, joy and new experiences. I will always be thankful to my school for shaping my future.

name: Abantika Bhoi | Grade: VIII
feedback: My school is a place where I learn, grow and make many beautiful memories. Coming to school makes me feel happy and joyful, which makes learning more interesting and exciting. Our honourable Principal and all the teachers are highly qualified, kind, friendly and always ready to help us. The classrooms are well designed and properly maintained, which helps me study peacefully. My school not only focuses on studies but also teaches good manners, discipline and respect. I feel proud to be a student of my school because it helps me become more confident and responsible day by day.

name: Shrividya Nayak | Grade: X
feedback: I am Shrividya Nayak, a student of Class X at Indian Public School, and I truly feel fortunate to be a part of this esteemed institution. Indian Public School is not just a place where I study; it is where my thoughts are shaped, my confidence is nurtured and my character continues to grow. Each day at school brings new learning—not only from textbooks but also from experiences that instil discipline, empathy, perseverance and self-belief. The teachers here are more than educators; they are dedicated mentors who inspire us to dream fearlessly, think independently, and overcome challenges with determination.

name: Avanti Pathak | Grade: X
feedback: I am Avanti Pathak, a student of Grade X at Indian Public School. My experience at this school has been truly enriching and inspiring. The teachers here are very supportive, knowledgeable, and always encourage us to give our best in academics as well as co-curricular activities. The school provides a positive learning environment where students are motivated to grow with confidence, discipline, and values. Various activities, competitions and practical learning opportunities have helped me improve my skills and overall personality. I feel proud to be a part of Indian Public School, which continuously guides and prepares us for a bright future.

name: Swastika Mahakul | XII JEE
feedback: I am grateful to my school for providing a strong academic foundation and a supportive learning environment. The dedicated teachers, well-structured curriculum, and disciplined atmosphere have helped me develop conceptual clarity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, which are essential for my JEE preparation. The constant guidance and encouragement from my teachers have motivated me to work harder and stay focused on my goals. I will always value the lessons and experiences gained here. I am very happy to be a part of this institution. Thank you.

name: Pragati Pradhan | XII NEET
feedback: I, Pragati Pradhan of Std. XII (NEET Science), experienced a very wonderful and enthusiastic journey at IPS. They have provided all essential support regarding our hostel and academic needs. They maintain a peaceful and disciplined environment, which helps students focus on their studies. Immediate action is taken to resolve any particular problem. They also provide excellent sports facilities and guidance in time management. As a NEET aspirant, I have received the best coaching facilities from Aakash and IPS. It has been a very grateful journey throughout the year. I am very happy to be a part of this family. Thank you!
